title: precheck warns when a sprint's committed selectors that collect no test outnumber the ids the test ceiling has left
goal: backlog.py precheck SP counts the committed items' check selectors that collect no test yet and the free ids of _tools/tests_ceiling.json (the headroom tests.py --ceiling reports) and warns before the start gate when the selectors outnumber them, so the plan decides up front which existing tests each new one renames and extends (SP-dqkf3i42 started with 97 of 100 ids used and nine selectors to collect, SP-uwkr7iyl planned four census stories a new test file each on a suite at 100 of 100 ids); the kb-sprint plan step that runs precheck and backlog.md's Sprints text name that warning as where the ids are planned

run: import sys;t=open(".claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md",encoding="utf-8").read();b=open("kb/_self/backlog.md",encoding="utf-8").read();s=[l for l in t.splitlines() if "backlog.py precheck SP" in l];r=[l for l in b.splitlines() if "precheck" in l and "free ids" in l];sys.exit(0 if s and "free ids" in s[0] and r else 1)

notes: SP-ciqk6gt6 close: the suite reached the 100-id ceiling at TK-7nnd2bdm, and five later items each had to extend or rename an existing test, told only through notes the orchestrator added at dispatch. Recurrence SP-m3azo2y7 (2026-10-10): ST-zltblzgq and ST-vblulwrc each needed a planted test at 100 of 100 ids; ST-zltblzgq stopped mid-work on blocking gate g2 to ask where the test goes. Merged from ST-vd3boyx5 at the 2026-10-12 draft triage: planning reads the headroom tests.py --ceiling reports against the ids its stories add, and the skill and backlog.md text join this story; it answers SP-uwkr7iyl, where four census stories each planned a new test file on a suite at 100 of 100 ids and ST-w3jhowin stopped on a blocking gate mid-work. Where the tests go, decided at planning: precheck lives in _tools/bl_land.py (cmd_precheck), not bl_plan.py; the selectors helper is bl_check.selector_rows; the check's selector names a test that does not exist yet, so the worker renames the existing test test_backlog_check_refuses_programs_outside_the_allowlist of _tools/test_check_programs.py by appending _and_precheck_selectors_outnumber_free_ids and extends it, adding no id (the suite is at 100 of 100). Premise run 2026-10-12: precheck SP-qlpfcgs2 prints no selector headroom line today, and backlog.py selectors lists 67 selectors of the open backlog that collect no test against 0 free ids. Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 14 of 19, "The whole suite fits its seconds ceiling under host load without the ceiling changing"): it fixes a failure that recurred in recent sprints and blocks the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test that a content sprint lands on headless Sonnet workers with no operator step beyond its gates.
